mentions.name: Pinggy
mentions.description: Pinggy is a tunneling tool that aims to be the easiest to use. A feature in development is an attachable public IP: users behind CGNAT can run the app and get a public IP instantly.
mentions.problem: People behind CGNAT cannot directly get a public IP address.
mentions.audience: People behind CGNAT who need a public IP address
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on Pinggy (https://pinggy.io/) to make it the easiest tunneling tool.

One feature we are working on is an attachable public IP. For those behind CGNAT, they can run this app and get a public IP instantly.
